Oakvale Driving School: Beginner Course
Home | Courses | Instructors | Enrollment | Contact
What has changed
Until last summer, a beginner's first lessons behind the wheel took place in ordinary road traffic, with other cars passing close by. Many beginners found those first lessons stressful. --[1]--. Those lessons are now held on a fenced practice ground away from public roads and reserved for our learners alone. This arrangement allows beginners to gain basic control of steering, stopping and turning before they encounter traffic at all. --[2]--.
How the course runs
The course is divided into three stages. In stage one, learners drive on the fenced ground only, in fifty-minute sessions with an instructor beside them. A stage two session on quiet local streets can be arranged only once an instructor has confirmed in writing that stage one has been completed. Stage three moves on to main roads and night driving. Learners who can provide proof of instruction received at another school are eligible to begin at stage two. --[3]--.
What we provide
A school car fitted with a second set of controls is supplied for every session, so no learner needs to bring a vehicle. In stage one, two learners share each car, taking turns at the wheel while the other observes. --[4]--.
Ready to start?
Complete the request form on our enrollment page, and the office will contact you to arrange a date for your first session.
Note: The fenced ground is closed to learners on Wednesday afternoons.

Review of Foxton Cleaning Services
Rating: 5 out of 5 stars
Posted by Delia Marsh, October 14
I run a small shop where customers browse the shelves before leaving with two paperbacks. It closes for only two hours each afternoon, and I refuse to shut out paying customers. Any cleaning had to fit into that short break. A cafe owner across the street recommended Foxton Cleaning Services, which mostly serves cafes and dental practices. The gym next door, however, suggested the Overnight Service.
Foxton offers four packages. The Maintenance Plan and the Overnight Service serve weekly clients and large sites. The Deep Refresh is a thorough cleaning lasting most of a day. The Express Clean is the quickest package and costs slightly more per hour than the Deep Refresh. Faster work, I assumed, meant weaker results, so the slowest package seemed best.
When I called, the staff suggested the Maintenance Plan, but I booked the quickest package instead. Having seen the prices, I was not surprised by its higher hourly rate. Although the Deep Refresh was available that week, I have not regretted turning it down.
On the day of the cleaning, the crew was gone before I reopened. The shelves were spotless, and the windows had not been so clear in years.
Looking back, I had the order exactly upside down. I will book the same package again but reserve it several days ahead, since same-day slots are rarely open.

To: Estelle Coyle
Date: August 14
Subject: Underhill year-end data handover
Dear Ms. Coyle,
Radcliffe Records Management is preparing to receive Underhill Consulting's year-end files, and our portal offers three upload routes for them. As the records coordinator who manages Underhill's document categories, you know better than I do how the files are grouped. Museum Displays Head Out to Local Halls
By Alma Reichert
Ledbury Regional History Museum has extended its traveling display program to community halls and branch libraries across the district. "Most of these objects have never left this building," said Gordon Nasser, the museum's director of collections, "and the people they belong to should not have to travel to see them."
Each display travels in sealed crates and is delivered and collected by museum staff. Venues that take part agree to count visitors daily and report the total when the display is returned. Available displays are listed on the museum's Web site.
